summary: Serves as the root source directory containing core domain modules that manage directory concepts, document generation, error handling, LLM context operations, package analysis, and README generation.
responsibilities: Manage directory concept construction and build result types.
Manage document generation, context initialization, data models, rendering, translation, and building operations.
Define domain-specific errors and phase classifications for error handling.
Manage the creation, definition, and generation of LLM context files and data structures.
Perform package analysis, concept generation, dependency collection, and path processing.
Coordinate the generation of project README files by managing build contexts and rendering options.
relationships: The directory coordinates core domain modules including directory building, document generation, error handling, LLM context operations, package analysis, and README generation.
Document generation coordinates document building, rendering, and translation processes.
ConceptError relates to ConceptPhase to classify errors during conceptual execution.
design_decisions: Modular organization grouping domain-specific operations such as directory concept building, document generation, error classification, LLM context handling, package analysis, and README generation.
